analysis: Two changed files. (1) docs/reports/README.md adds one index link at head line 261 to a new Nemotron Super image-ingress measurements report. This is documentation only, with no code, key, attestation or authorization behavior. The linked report file is not in the supplied evidence, so its content is unreviewed. The index describes records as non-fresh and non-proof, which is consistent with TB-011's limitations. (2) provider-swift/.../EngineV2Bridge+Events.swift adds one line at head line 141, `if let gate = _testPersistentBeforeNativeTerminal { await gate(usage) }`. The line sits inside the surrounding `#if` block next to the existing `_testBeforeNativeTerminal` hook (lines ~138-141), and the visible `#endif` follows it. The patch shows the `#if` condition only as context. The `#if` opener is not visible, so I did not confirm that it is DEBUG/test-only. Assuming it is, this is a test-only hook that adds no production attack surface. It does not touch encryption (T-008), cancellation (T-010) or App Attest authorization (TB-011, T-053). If the guard were not a test or debug condition, a persistent async gate before the native terminal event could stall a stream, a minor availability concern. The supplied evidence does not establish that, so it is not a finding. The declaration of `_testPersistentBeforeNativeTerminal` is not in the supplied patch, so I did not verify its access level or that it is compiled out of release builds. No threat-model update is needed.
